source.publisher: Supreme Council of the de facto Transnistrian administration, describing its own jurisdiction (not internationally recognized state authority)
source.revision_note: Official website labels Appendix 1 current 25.03.2023; text notes Law 48-ЗИ-VII 24 March 2023
source.parse_scope: Russian-language state register section only; source-paragraph positions count nonempty paragraphs as stored in DOCX
source.annex2_description: State register of compatible/previously used names, amendments through February 2021

limitations: Matching a locality in a de facto 2023 legal register is evidence of a dated normative claim, not effective control or authority over the whole ACTUAL polygon.
Names recurring in multiple administrative regions or roles must not be matched by OSM containment alone.
No amendment-by-amendment certification that 25.03.2023 is still legally operative without change at 15.10.2026.
A council is a semantic intermediate level; not the polygon parent automatically.
Cross-language aliases require independent identity authority before acceptance.
No source certifies geometric role/version equality with live OSM in October 2026.

role_exception.source_note: 2023 legislative publications describe Lunga as a Dubăsari urban microraion, not explicitly as a distinct village in Annex 1. The older OSM polygon cannot be presumed to represent a separate de facto village.

documentary_method: Normalize exact locality tokens in Russian Annex 1, retrieve dated region/council and paragraph index; use Annex 2 to verify named equivalences, not geometry or legal MD CUATM. All OSM IDs in region crosswalk are analyst mappings, NOT identifiers assigned by normative source.
